name: Casino x Forte x Scandal
source:
In Sonora, the casino is your king.  Money, fame, power... it can all be obtained by gambling. All it takes is a bit of confidence - and a lot of luck - to make it big!

For Angel Valentine, however, this philosophy does not apply to him. Working at a top news agency, his job always comes first, and the concept of free will is completely foreign to him. But when he gets assigned a high-profile case of people suddenly going missing in Sonora's largest casino, his life is flipped on its head.

Friends, foes, and mysterious third parties will all try to interfere with Angel's pursuit of the truth, and it's up to him to decide who he can trust. But the truth never comes easy...

What are you willing to risk to find it?
